_frozen: 2026-10-13 — declared BEFORE any spike code. This set does not change to flatter results. Envelopes are orthogonal polygons in metres, origin at the north-west corner, y grows toward the garden; the street is the y = 0 edge unless stated. Areas are GROSS built area with the Stage 3 verdict tolerances (meets ≤10 %, disclosed ≤50 %). Rooms list is the net programme; roles follow ProgramRole.
_hard_constraints_every_case: every cell inside the envelope polygon
every listed contact is a positive-length shared wall
every listed access pair carries a door of its class width with corner margins
REQUIRED exposure rooms touch an exterior wall
every ZoneIntent bound (net area, min short side, max aspect) holds
entrance opens into an allowed arrival room that fronts the street
topology preservation n/n for contacts and doors

cases.purpose: Control. The rectangle the current band pipeline already plans; the general path must not do worse here.
cases.baseline: Stage 3 band pipeline: plans (B11-class brief), 89–91 % gross, arrival at circulation on ≥1 parti

cases.purpose: Exterior shape as an INPUT constraint: a corner of the parcel is unbuildable (easement). The building must be non-rectangular to use the area; the street edge is the short north edge.
cases.baseline: no rectangle of 190 m2 fits this envelope (max inscribed rectangle 8x16 = 128 m2, 14x9 = 126 m2): the current pipeline cannot plan it at all

cases.purpose: Exterior shape as a DESIGN VARIABLE: a wide, shallow buildable strip where a single rectangle leaves 5 bedrooms without exposure or produces the 14 m corridor. Offset/stepped wings are the architectural answer; nothing names them.
cases.baseline: unseen brief U4 (22x8.5) was REFUSED by production and by the brain (ROOM_SHAPE_INFEASIBLE); this case is the same failure mode with 1.5 m more depth

cases.purpose: A notch on the STREET side (entry court): the arrival room must front the street inside the notch's edges, and the public band must still face the garden. Tests frontage + notch together.
cases.baseline: not plannable today: every street-facing band would cross the notch

cases.purpose: A rear notch (garden court) with an open-plan LDK that must wrap it: the row containing the court is TWO intervals. Under formulation A this is expected to REFUSE with a typed reason (a band with a gap); it is here to expose that limit, and B (MILP) is expected to solve it.
cases.expected: FEASIBLE (exists) — A may refuse: EMBEDDING/BAND_GAP; that refusal must be typed, never a timeout or a distorted plan

cases.purpose: Deliberately unsatisfiable by REPRESENTATION: LIVING, KITCHEN, HALL and the MASTER bedroom all required to touch each other pairwise (a K4), which no rectangle dissection can carry. The correct answer is a typed refusal before any geometry, not a solver timeout, not a plan that drops a contact.
cases.expected: REFUSE: TOPOLOGY_REPRESENTATION_LIMIT (K4) — in < 1 s, with the four rooms named
cases.baseline: the current critic (I6) and band_embedding already detect K4 on a rectangle; the general path must keep that behaviour on any envelope

_scoring: Gate 2: ≥4/6 FEASIBLE cases solved with every hard constraint; F6 must refuse correctly (a plan here is a FAIL). Gate 3: ≥5/6 usable + ≤30 s per case on this machine + materially different alternatives where feasible.
_revision: v1.1 (2026-10-13, after the first run, DECLARED): the first run showed the brain's programme carries no DINING room for these briefs, so F6's K4 silently collapsed into a triangle and 'solved' (a FAIL by this file's own rule) and F4's DINING contacts could not exist. F6's K4 is restated over roles every programme carries (LIVING, KITCHEN, HALL, MASTER_BEDROOM); F4's dining contacts become KITCHEN-LIVING. The harness now REFUSES a case naming a missing role instead of dropping the pair. Nothing else changed; the change makes the set stricter, not easier.
